items.title: We Are His House
items.summary: Becoming a Christian and being a Christian happen in the same way: by hoping in Jesus.

items.title: Wipe Your Fears Away
items.summary: When anxiety blurs our vision of God’s glory, it does not mean that we are faithless. It means our faith is being attacked.

items.title: Marveling at the End of History
items.summary: One day, we will see God’s glory, and marvel at it in such a way that he will be glorified in us for all the world to see.

items.title: We Honor What We Enjoy
items.summary: It is possible to pursue God without glorifying God. If we want our quest to honor God, we must pursue him for the joy of fellowship with him.

items.title: Is God’s Love Conditional?
items.summary: There are precious experiences of the love of God that require that we fight pride, seek humility, and cherish the nearness of God.

items.title: Love One Another Gladly
items.summary: Loving acts are genuine to the degree that they are not done begrudgingly.

items.title: Do You Neglect Your Salvation?
items.summary: Being a Christian is a very serious business, though not a sour business. We are simply blood-earnest about being happy in our great salvation.

items.title: The Flavors of Holy Joy
items.summary: A well-cooked meal and a newborn baby fill our hearts with different delights. Pastor John explains how God’s gifts offer us a multicolored experience of joy.

items.title: How Evil Works
items.summary: How does Satan influence the world, and where do we see his work most clearly? Pastor John describes Satan’s power and limits under Christ’s victorious work.

items.title: Peace for Second-Guessers
items.summary: How do we know when we’ve worked hard enough? Pastor John offers six ways to fight anxiety and rest in the grace of Christ.

items.title: Was Piper Unprepared?
items.summary: In 1980, Bethlehem Baptist Church hired 34-year-old John Piper as lead pastor. Pastor John reflects on the life experience and biblical worldview that prepared him for ministry.

items.title: Happiness Myths to Avoid
items.summary: Modern psychology defines happiness as “self-fulfillment.” But without God, our souls will always long for greater satisfaction and joy.

items.title: When God Is Against Me
items.summary: Can God act as a Christian’s enemy through suffering? Pastor John explains how God’s painful providences do not conflict with his enduring love for his children.

items.title: I Am the Shepherd
items.summary: Throughout the Bible, Jesus uses a variety of metaphors that explain who he is and the salvation he offers us. But the image of the Great Shepherd gives us wonderful insight into not just what Jesus does for us, but why he chooses to do it. What does Jesus mean when he calls us his sheep, and what does this mean for…

items.summary: This sermon was preached by Dr. Timothy Keller at Redeemer Presbyterian Church on November 22, 1998. Series: John – On Knowing the Christ. Scripture: John 8:12-18; 25-30. Today's podcast is brought to you by Gospel in Life, the site for all sermons, books, study guides and resources from Timothy Keller and Redeemer…

items.title: Come and See
items.summary: This sermon was preached by Dr. Timothy Keller at Redeemer Presbyterian Church on November 15, 1998. Series: John – On Knowing the Christ. Scripture: John 1:35-51. Today's podcast is brought to you by Gospel in Life, the site for all sermons, books, study guides and resources from Timothy Keller and Redeemer…

items.title: Sex and the Romantic Solution (Open Forum)
items.summary: This talk was given by Dr. Timothy Keller at Redeemer Presbyterian Church on May 8, 2014. Series: Redeemer Open Forums. Today's podcast is brought to you by Gospel in Life, the site for all sermons, books, study guides and resources from Timothy Keller and Redeemer Presbyterian Church. If you've enjoyed listening to…

items.title: The Lions of God
items.summary: When we go out into the world as Christians, Jesus says our lives will have three characteristics. First, we are salt that preserves the people and societies around us from decay. Second, we will inevitably be hurt by those who misunderstand or reject our beliefs. Lastly, we will be like a light on a hill that…

items.title: The Finger on the Wall
items.summary: We all have a deep desire for our lives to have real significance. But when we try to find that fulfillment in romance, creativity, careers, or even religious obedience, we miss the only real solution there is: hope in Jesus Christ. Daniel shows us that when we trust in God’s Word, lay down our pride, and learn the…

items.title: Gratitude in Affliction
items.summary: Genuine praise can't be manufactured. It comes from thanking Him in both the sorrows and the joys.

items.title: Think on These Things
items.summary: As we dwell on things that are true and beautiful, God gives us a peace that surpasses all understanding.

items.title: Who’s in Control of Our Thoughts?
items.summary: What we dwell on shapes who we become. Allow the Holy Spirit to guide your thoughts toward Christ.

items.title: Loved and Found
items.summary: Because of Jesus, the door to salvation is open—we need only to walk through it.

items.title: What We’ve Been Looking For
items.summary: Jesus came to seek and save the lost, bringing life to those who put their trust in Him.

items.title: Peace With God
items.summary: Peace isn't the absence of conflict—it's the presence of the triune God at work in our life. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Wholehearted Worship
items.summary: The Lord calls us to worship Him wholeheartedly every day of the week.

items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Ezra 4:4–6, David Platt urges us to endure in faith amid discouragement or fear. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Sincere Worship (Ezra 3:11–13)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Ezra 3:11–13, David Platt encourages us to present ourselves sincerely before the Lord. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Almighty Lord (Ezra 1:1)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Ezra 1:1, David Platt reflects on God’s sovereignty in accomplishing his purposes. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Providence At Work (2 Chronicles 36:22–23)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Chronicles 36:22–23, David Platt reflects on God’s triumph over sin and suffering. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Faith, Perseverance & Prayer (2 Chronicles 35:22)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Chronicles 35:22, David Platt reflects on the necessity of prayer for perseverance. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: You Are Never Beyond the Reach of God
items.summary: There is nowhere you can go, nothing you can face, and no situation you can encounter where God is absent. His omnipresence is a source of comfort for believers, reminding us that we are never beyond His reach. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how God's presence provides security and calls us to live with…

items.title: Nothing Is Hidden from God
items.summary: God doesn't just know about you. He knows you completely. His knowledge is perfect, personal, and without limitation. In this episode, Costi Hinn unpacks the omniscience of God and explains why being fully known by Him should change the way we live, pray, and respond to sin.

items.title: Nothing Happens Outside the Rule of God
items.summary: We often live as though everything depends on us, carrying the weight of circumstances we cannot control. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how understanding the sovereignty of God changes the way we approach uncertainty, suffering, and our daily lives. Resources: Earth's Epic Start: A Bible Study About God’s…

items.title: God’s Love Begins With Him, Not You
items.summary: God’s love is not something we earn through our obedience, nor is it an excuse to continue in sin. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how God’s love flows from His character, is revealed through Jesus Christ, and transforms how we love others. Resources: In Jesus' Name I Pray: TJ the Squirrel Learns the True Heart…

items.title: When God’s Glory Exposes Your Sin
items.summary: We are often quick to recognize the sins of others while overlooking our own. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how seeing God in His holiness strips away our excuses, exposes our sin, and calls us to genuine repentance.
